children: Czech ruling coalition parties have reached an agreement on the  2027 central state budget proposal, with a deficit several billions of crowns lower than the 389 billion crowns ($18.36 billion), news agency CTK quoted Motorists party leader Petr Macinka as saying on Thursday.

Macinka said the agreement will allow the government meeting on Monday to approve the proposal, which would put the public sector deficit at 3.5% of gross domestic product, above 2.7% expected this year and the government's pledge to keep it under 3%.
